name: 保罗·狄拉克
bio_short: 英国理论物理学家，量子力学的奠基人之一。他提出了描述电子相对论性行为的“狄拉克方程”，预言了“反物质”的存在，并与费米共同创立了“费米-狄拉克统计”（`fermi_dirac_statistics_1926`）。
bio_short_en: A British theoretical physicist and a founder of quantum mechanics. He formulated the 'Dirac Equation' to describe the relativistic behavior of electrons, predicted the existence of 'antimatter', and co-founded 'Fermi-Dirac statistics' (`fermi_dirac_statistics_1926`) with Enrico Fermi.
